subject.title: Text between tool calls leaks to messaging channels

question: Should normal source-visible chats continue automatic bare-text delivery by default, or should channel/source replies become final-only or message-tool-only for pre- and inter-tool assistant text?
rationale: The current docs and tests preserve automatic delivery, but the same default can leak internal reasoning, tool arguments, or progress prose into external user channels.

options.title: Make source delivery private by default for intermediate text
options.body: Adopt a generic boundary that never sends pre/inter-tool assistant text to channels, while preserving explicit final/message-tool sends and documenting any compatibility switch or migration.

options.title: Keep automatic defaults with opt-in strict mode
options.body: Preserve current visible-reply behavior and only expose a safer final-only/message-tool-only mode for users who configure it explicitly.

options.title: Land only narrow subset fixes
options.body: Fix commentary, NO_REPLY, and cron reasoning filters independently while leaving the broader automatic source-reply policy open.

recommendation.title: Make source delivery private by default for intermediate text
recommendation.body: Adopt a generic boundary that never sends pre/inter-tool assistant text to channels, while preserving explicit final/message-tool sends and documenting any compatibility switch or migration.
